experiences.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
experiences.description:
Engineered full-stack application features using Java, Spring Boot, React.js, and TypeScript, translating business requirements into scalable functionality and supporting delivery of 15+ application enhancements.
Developed and integrated REST APIs using Spring Boot and Spring MVC, connecting frontend components with backend business logic and improving service response times by 25% through application optimization.
Built responsive user interfaces using React.js, Angular, HTML5, CSS3, and Redux, improving application usability and reducing frontend defect rework by 20%.
Designed database-driven application functionality using SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and Oracle, applying data modeling, indexing, and query optimization to support 10+ business workflows.
Implemented secure application access using Spring Security, OAuth 2.0, JWT, and RBAC, supporting authentication and authorization requirements across 8+ application modules.
Contributed to microservices-based application development using Microservices Architecture, API Gateway, and Service Integration, supporting scalable backend functionality and reducing service integration effort by 20%.
Supported cloud-native deployment workflows using AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins, contributing to 12+ application releases through CI/CD pipelines.
Developed automated unit and integration tests using JUnit, Mockito, Jest, and API Testing, improving regression coverage across 40+ test scenarios and supporting application quality.
Participated in code reviews, architecture discussions, Agile/Scrum ceremonies, and production troubleshooting, resolving 25+ application issues and documenting technical solutions for ongoing maintenance.
